app.title: Rhythm Hero
home.tagline: Learn rhythm by clapping or tapping on the table
mic.title: Microphone tester
mic.intro: Clap or tap the table. First you hear one bar of claves; then the app goes quiet and you keep the pulse you see on screen.
mic.privacy: Sound is analysed only on this device: it is never recorded or sent.
mic.status.ready: Ready. Clap once to try it.
mic.offset.early: On average you are {ms} ms early.
mic.offset.late: On average you are {ms} ms late.
mic.offset.none: No claps were detected in time.
mic.error.denied: There is no permission to use the microphone. Allow it in your browser settings and try again.
mic.error.unavailable: No microphone was found, or another app is using it.
mic.error.unsupported: This browser cannot use the microphone. Try an up-to-date Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari.
